origin.description: Convert raw moments to central moments.

arguments.name: mu.raw
arguments.text: Raw moments from order 0 upward. In Python the argument is mu_raw.

origin.details: The order-0 result is 1. Each later order is the binomial expansion of the raw moments about the first raw moment. A data frame comes back as a matrix and keeps its column names.
origin.value: Central moments in the same positions as the raw moments.
